CONTRACT NEGOTIATION

Experts Negotiating For You

Better rates, credits, and hardware offers.

Key Capabilities

Insider Advantage Our team’s background in the carrier industry means we know exactly how the system works.

Unmatched Leverage Representing over 350,000 wireless lines gives us significant bargaining power.

Savings-Based Pricing Our compensation model is simple: we only earn a percentage of the savings we deliver. No upfront fees.

Disruption-less We recover billing errors and optimize costs without forcing you to switch providers. Your existing carrier relationship stays intact while we maximize value.

Lasting Results Our negotiation doesn’t stop at signing. We work proactively to keep your pricing competitive year after year.

Managed Mobility Solutions

Wireless support and monthly optimization.

Service Features

White-Glove Device Setup Complete configuration and deployment of new devices with user training and documentation

Instant Technical Support Expert troubleshooting for connectivity issues, app problems, and device malfunctions via phone, chat, or email

Plan Management & Changes Seamless modifications to service plans, features, and add-ons without carrier hold times or confusion

Emergency Device Replacement Same-day or next-day device replacement with expedited shipping and pre-configuration

User Training & Onboarding Comprehensive training programs for new devices, applications, and mobile security best practices

Expertel iQ

Introducing the Enhanced Expertel iQ Dashboard

Your wireless usage and cost dashboard.

Platform Features

Real-Time Analytics Monitor your entire wireless ecosystem with live data visualization, spending trends, and usage patterns across all devices and carriers.

Automated Auditing AI-powered bill analysis automatically detects billing errors, unused services, and optimization opportunities—saving you hours of manual review.

Device Lifecycle Management Complete visibility and control over device procurement, deployment, usage monitoring, and end-of-life management from a single dashboard.

Instant Alerts & Actions Receive immediate notifications about cost anomalies, contract renewals, and optimization opportunities with one-click implementation.

Buyback

Device Buyback & Trade-In Program

Recover value from old devices and cut hardware spend.

Program Benefits

Premium Market Valuations Competitive pricing that typically exceeds carrier trade-in values by 20-40%

Streamlined Process Simple online portal for device evaluation, pickup scheduling, and payment processing

Certified Data Destruction Military-grade data wiping with certificates of destruction for compliance and security

Environmental Responsibility Certified recycling programs that meet all environmental standards and regulations

Bulk Processing Capabilities Efficient handling of large device retirement projects with dedicated project management
